findings.body: The egress module is added without a `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` guard. If this module depends on voice‑specific code or crates, building the crate with the `voice` feature disabled will now fail with unresolved imports or missing types. Add the same cfg attribute that guards the other voice modules to prevent this regression.
findings.title: Guard the egress module with cfg(feature = "voice")

value.summary: The newly added `mod egress;` is not guarded by the `#[cfg(feature = "voice")]` attribute, which likely causes compilation failures when the "voice" feature is disabled.
